task_summary: Implement normalize in solution.py, add public unittest regression coverage in test_solution.py, and document design decisions and the verification command in HANDOFF.md.
constraints: Work only within the supplied task workspace; do not access parent repositories or external services.
Use Python 3.11+ and the standard library.
Maintain type hints and do not mutate input collections.
Public behavior: replace CRLF and lone CR with LF; preserve existing LF, all other characters, and the number of line breaks; do not strip trailing newlines.
No algorithmic complexity constraint is imposed.

success_criteria.description: The public tests include at least three unittest test methods.

check.command: python -c 'import ast; from pathlib import Path; tree = ast.parse(Path("test_solution.py").read_text()); count = sum(isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name.startswith("test") for cls in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(cls, ast.ClassDef) and any((isinstance(base, ast.Name) and base.id == "TestCase") or (isinstance(base, ast.Attribute) and base.attr == "TestCase") for base in cls.bases) for node in cls.body); assert count >= 3'

success_criteria.description: The unittest discovery command completes successfully.
HANDOFF.md records design decisions and the verification command.

check.pattern: (?is)(design decision|design choice).*(python -m unittest discover -v)|(python -m unittest discover -v).*(design decision|design choice)

verification.command: python -c 'import ast; from pathlib import Path; tree = ast.parse(Path("test_solution.py").read_text()); count = sum(isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef)) and node.name.startswith("test") for cls in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(cls, ast.ClassDef) and any((isinstance(base, ast.Name) and base.id == "TestCase") or (isinstance(base, ast.Attribute) and base.attr == "TestCase") for base in cls.bases) for node in cls.body); assert count >= 3'

assumptions: The named files solution.py, test_solution.py, and HANDOFF.md are relative paths in the supplied task workspace; requested output files may not exist yet and may be created.
The normalize function belongs in solution.py and is the public API exercised by tests in test_solution.py.
The standard library unittest discovery command `python -m unittest discover -v` discovers the public tests in the supplied workspace.
The HANDOFF.md design decisions and verification command can be documented in prose; the content check expects a design-decision phrase and the exact verification command to appear in the same file.
